title: The same table function with a VAL parameter compares one value with itself and returns no rows
query: VAR BestCustomersResult = FILTER ( Customer, metricVal > AverageMetric )

source.quote: Changing the parameter type to VAL produces an empty result.
source.supports: the article gives this function and says it returns an empty table

derivation: metricVal is evaluated once by the caller: 540. The average of 540 over the four customers is 540, and 540 > 540 is FALSE for every row, so the table is empty.
